owner: constraint-layered ranks, internal routing statistics, independent Agent oracle and coverage ledger
problem: Existing implementation can move roots inward and attribute some edge metrics, but public evidence does not demonstrate middle-column roots, leaf nodes have no statistics, per-edge distinct crossing partners are unknown, and no executable feature-interaction coverage ledger exists.
scope: Any zero-indegree component, every logical node and edge, project test-space coverage and packaged examples; public draw CLI and logical topology remain unchanged.
baseline: ALAP ranks and per-edge length/crossing-event reports exist, but there is no dedicated middle-root example, no every-node report, no crossed-edge count, and no machine-checked feature-to-interaction traceability.
benchmarks: ELK Layered phase separation and node promotion
yFiles weighted/tight-tree/downshift layering and edge grouping
NIST ACTS t-way covering arrays and coverage measurement
advantages: Current rank computation is topology-only and already preserves forward edges
Current production and independent geometry sweeps already agree on length and crossing incidents
Release gates already consume source and frozen artifacts
disadvantages: Existing examples hide the middle-column source behavior
Current source-only aggregation omits sinks and intermediate node commonality
Crossing incidents do not answer how many distinct other edges one edge crosses
Test quantity is not an auditable feature-space coverage result
limitations: Exact global minimum crossing layout is computationally hard
Synthetic and public examples do not prove equivalence to an unavailable confidential production corpus
Agent statistics remain a quality tool and are not a public draw subcommand
defects: Missing executable high-risk interaction coverage ledger
bottlenecks: High-fanout crossing partner attribution must avoid Cartesian pair lists
Feature-space enumeration can grow combinatorially without risk-ranked interaction selection

metrics.name: middle-column root feasibility
metrics.threshold: every single-child unconstrained root equals its latest feasible forward rank; multi-child roots pass the complete candidate vector
metrics.measurement: independent ASAP/ALAP final-axis oracle for low-use roots plus production/property quality comparison for shared roots
metrics.evidence: public example, renamed/reordered metamorphic case and full forced-first-column relayout mutant

metrics.name: per-edge crossing partners
metrics.threshold: production equals independent oracle and is symmetric
metrics.measurement: orthogonal sweep with compact owner bitsets

metrics.name: per-node observability
metrics.measurement: node report keys equal config node keys including leaves

metrics.name: feature coverage
metrics.unit: required feature roles and declared interactions
metrics.measurement: machine validator over frozen coverage ledger

metrics.name: packaged behavior
metrics.measurement: PATH-isolated frozen and source release runs

hypotheses: Latest-feasible DAG ranks are the general structural rule for low-use sources
Integer owner bitsets give exact crossed-edge counts without materializing partner tuples
A risk-ranked feature/interaction ledger exposes coverage holes that pytest count and code coverage miss

stages.output: two examples, coverage contract and negative mutants

stages.rollback: retain current ALAP engine and fix only general owner

stages.checker: full delivery and remote asset gates

hard_gates: Every edge remains forward and exact-port attached
Every logical node and edge appears exactly once in statistics
Crossed-edge counts are symmetric and independently equal
Every required coverage role and declared interaction has direct evidence
Source, frozen and remote packaged examples agree
failure_fixtures: low-use roots unnecessarily pinned beside a common root
edge pair crossing twice but counted as one distinct partner and two incidents
coverage ledger with a removed cross-feature scenario
release archive missing a documented example
success_fixtures: root with no slack remains first
low-use roots with four layers of slack move beside their merge targets
distant root consumers use only justified aliases
crossing and non-crossing edges receive exact partner counts
fault_injections: force every root to rank zero and rerun complete placement/routing
rollback: Reject the candidate at the first hard-gate failure and keep the frozen negative artifacts; no post-generation coordinate repair is permitted.

iteration_budget.review_trigger: a second failure changes the model, measurement or owner

stop_conditions: Both public examples meet their coordinate and quality contracts
Production and independent complete statistics match
Coverage validator kills all frozen mutants

promotion_decision.reason: Both responsibilities already have narrow owners; no new top-level skill is justified.

writeback: Project-specific evidence stays in the worklog; general feature-space coverage goes to agent-quality-workflow and free layered source/statistics rules go to clock-tree-layout.
